# Vox
> Vox is a general interest news site focused on explanatory journalism across politics, policy, science, technology, culture, climate, health, and everyday life.

Vox publishes reported news, analysis, explainers, videos, podcasts, and advice aimed at helping readers understand complex issues and current events. Its coverage spans public policy, world affairs, economics, culture, science, and practical life topics.

## Main Sections
- [Homepage](https://www.vox.com): Front page featuring top stories, explainers, and the latest reporting across all desks.
- [Explainers](https://www.vox.com/explainers): Core Vox format with accessible explanations of major news events and complex topics.
- [Politics](https://www.vox.com/politics): Coverage of US politics, elections, government, law, and public policy.
- [Culture](https://www.vox.com/culture): Reporting and criticism on entertainment, media, books, internet culture, and trends.
- [Advice](https://www.vox.com/advice): Service journalism and guidance on work, relationships, money, and daily life.
- [Science](https://www.vox.com/science): Science reporting on research, health, space, psychology, and the natural world.
- [Technology](https://www.vox.com/technology): Coverage of AI, platforms, gadgets, tech policy, and the digital economy.
- [Climate](https://www.vox.com/climate): Reporting on climate change, energy, environment, and climate policy.

## News Desks
- [Health](https://www.vox.com/health): Public health, medicine, mental health, healthcare systems, and wellness coverage.
- [Money](https://www.vox.com/money): Personal finance, labor, business, inflation, housing, and the broader economy.
- [Life](https://www.vox.com/life): Stories about relationships, family, identity, work, and how people live.
- [Future Perfect](https://www.vox.com/future-perfect): Coverage of effective altruism, global health, animal welfare, and doing good better.
- [Politics](https://www.vox.com/politics): Analysis of legislation, campaigns, courts, and political institutions.
- [Culture](https://www.vox.com/culture): Essays, reviews, and reporting on culture and entertainment.
- [Science](https://www.vox.com/science): Explanatory reporting on discoveries, evidence, and scientific debates.
- [Technology](https://www.vox.com/technology): Reporting on emerging technologies and their social and political effects.

## Formats
- [Explainers](https://www.vox.com/explainers): Signature explanatory articles that provide context, background, and key takeaways.
- [Videos](https://www.vox.com/videos): Video journalism and visual explainers on news, history, science, and culture.
- [Podcasts](https://www.vox.com/podcasts): Audio shows covering daily news, ideas, interviews, and analysis.
- [Advice](https://www.vox.com/advice): Reported guidance and practical answers to personal and social questions.
- [Crossword](https://www.vox.com/21523212/crossword-puzzles-free-daily-printable): Daily and printable crossword puzzles hosted by Vox.
- [Newsletters](https://www.vox.com/newsletters): Email newsletters featuring curated reporting, analysis, and recurring columns.

## Politics and Policy
- [Politics](https://www.vox.com/politics): Main politics hub for elections, Congress, the presidency, and the courts.
- [Climate](https://www.vox.com/climate): Climate policy, environmental regulation, and energy transition reporting.
- [Health](https://www.vox.com/health): Healthcare policy, public health systems, and medical access coverage.
- [Money](https://www.vox.com/money): Economic policy, labor issues, inflation, taxes, and consumer finances.
- [Future Perfect](https://www.vox.com/future-perfect): Policy-minded coverage of philanthropy, global development, and ethics.
- [Explainers](https://www.vox.com/explainers): Backgrounders on legislation, institutions, and major policy debates.

## Science, Tech, and Environment
- [Science](https://www.vox.com/science): Research-driven stories on biology, psychology, space, and scientific uncertainty.
- [Technology](https://www.vox.com/technology): AI, social media, antitrust, privacy, and technology industry coverage.
- [Climate](https://www.vox.com/climate): Climate science, extreme weather, biodiversity, and decarbonization reporting.
- [Health](https://www.vox.com/health): Medical science, disease, nutrition, mental health, and evidence-based health reporting.
- [Explainers](https://www.vox.com/explainers): Accessible explainers on scientific and technological developments.

## Culture and Everyday Life
- [Culture](https://www.vox.com/culture): Criticism and reporting on film, television, music, books, and online culture.
- [Life](https://www.vox.com/life): Features on relationships, parenting, identity, and modern living.
- [Advice](https://www.vox.com/advice): Practical service journalism on social dilemmas and personal decisions.
- [Money](https://www.vox.com/money): Consumer-focused coverage of spending, saving, debt, and work.
- [Health](https://www.vox.com/health): Everyday health, wellness, and mental health guidance grounded in reporting.

## Audio and Video
- [Videos](https://www.vox.com/videos): Video hub for visual explainers, documentaries, and short-form journalism.
- [Podcasts](https://www.vox.com/podcasts): Central directory for Vox podcasts and audio programming.
- [Today, Explained](https://www.vox.com/today-explained): Daily news podcast explaining one major story shaping the world.
- [The Gray Area](https://www.vox.com/the-gray-area): Interview podcast exploring difficult questions in politics, culture, and philosophy.
- [Unexplainable](https://www.vox.com/unexplainable): Science podcast about unanswered questions and mysteries of the universe.
